name: Golden-Tempered Jade
desc: A chicken dish native to Liyue. Prepared with simple spices, it strives to highlight the authentic flavor of fresh ingredients. The finished dish has smooth skin, tender meat, and a fresh taste, and is especially delightful when paired with a dipping sauce.

value.text: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.
